In May 2026, ClearPoint Neuro reported its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company delivered 43% year-on-year growth in revenue to USD 12.1 million, driven by an expansion of the activated installed base to more than 175 global centers and ongoing integration of the recently-acquired IRRAflow product portfolio. Organic growth amounted to 16% year on year (25% for devices), while the gross margin expanded to 64% over the period on account of lower allowances for excess and obsolete inventory.

Topline growth was driven by the neurosurgery navigation, therapy and access division, which achieved an 80% increase in revenue to USD 5.9 million, benefitting from contributions from the IRRAflow product line and the 3.0 operating room navigation software. Capital equipment and software revenue increased by 177% from a low base due to an increase in placements of ClearPoint navigation capital and software, IRRAflow control units, and Prism laser units. Meanwhile, biologics and drug delivery revenue was broadly flat compared with the prior year. 

Meanwhile, the company continues to progress its clinical trial program, which now covers more than 60 active biopharma partners. Notably, FDA clearance was received and first clinical procedures completed utilizing the company's Velocity Alpha MR High Speed Surgical Drill System. Elsewhere, Health Canada issued a medical device license for the ClearPoint Neuro Navigation System, which covers both MRI-guidance and iCT guidance workflows, while the first commercial drug delivery case utilizing ClearPoint technology was completed in the Asia-Pacific region.

The company provided updated revenue guidance of USD 52-56 million for 2026.
